meta.name: poc
meta.description: Run a bounded customer proof of concept to test a consequential uncertainty. Use for a spike or pilot with a question and decision deadline, not a full rollout.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一次小范围客户试用变成有明确结论的验证,按期给出继续或放弃的决定
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面前有个说不准的大方向,想先花小代价试出答案再决定投不投入。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a small customer trial into a clear go or no-go decision by a set date
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a big uncertainty stands in the way and you must decide whether to invest further.

howto.what: Claude 会按有边界的客户概念验证来推进:围绕一个关键不确定性设定要验证的问题和决策截止日期,产出试点(小规模试验)结果,不做完整上线。
howto.when: 当你要做一次 spike 或试点,且已有明确待验证的问题和决策截止日期时,它会接管;完整上线不在其范围内。

say.text: 帮我跑一个客户概念验证:要验证的问题是 X,决策截止日在下周五。
say.note: 会围绕该问题与截止日推进试点。

say.text: 这只是个 spike,只测一个问题,别扩成完整上线。
沿用 @fde 已有的脱敏信息包和范围,别重新走一遍发现流程。
say.note: 直接复用现有范围与已知答案。

howto.what_en: Claude runs a bounded customer proof of concept to test one consequential uncertainty: it frames a question and a decision deadline, produces spike/pilot findings, and stops short of full rollout.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a spike or pilot that has a clear question and a decision deadline; full rollout is out of scope.

say_en.text: Run a customer POC for me: the question is X and the decision deadline is next Friday.
say_en.note: Proceeds around that question and deadline.

say_en.text: This is just a spike — test one question, don't expand it into a full rollout.
Reuse @fde's existing sanitized packet and scope; don't redo discovery.
say_en.note: Builds on the current scope and answered questions.
